title: Summit and Provision
author: Elodie Winterbourne
blurb: Yara Dunmore, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
